author: SickProdigy
description: Various role utility commands, including reaction roles, sticky roles, self roles, auto roles, buttons, selects, and temporary roles.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs for the purpose of re-assigning sticky roles when a user rejoins a server. User IDs may also appear in bot logs.
install_msg: Use `[p]roletools` to manage role tools. Remember that role names are case sensitive.
name: RoleTools
